title: Settings
profileNote: Update your name and phone number. Your phone number is used for gate pass OTP verification.
pushNote: Get system-level alerts when an approval is required, even when the website is closed or minimized.
prefNote: Choose which types of push notifications you want to receive. Muted categories will not trigger a push, even if you are subscribed.
pinNote: Your 4-digit PIN is used with your phone number to sign in. No OTP needed after setting it.
projNote: These addresses are used in Purchase Order PDFs. The total budget is used for dashboard tracking.
updateNote: Fetch the latest version — new features, fixes and updated app icons. The app reloads automatically after updating.
name: Name
roleHelp: Role can only be changed by an admin via the Users tab
hospitalHelp: This name appears on PO PDFs and across the app
panHelp: Company PAN shown on PO PDFs
logoHint: Upload company logo for PO PDFs (optional)
logoutNote: Sign out of this device. You will need to log in again to continue.
n_entity_created_desc: PO, quotation, invoice, payment, etc. created by your team
n_approval_request_desc: A document is waiting for your approval
n_approval_result_desc: Your document was approved or rejected
